public static final RegistryEntry<Item> SPACE_PANTS = BASIC_ITEMS.register("space_pants", () -> new CustomDyeableArmorItem(SpaceSuitMaterial.MATERIAL, ArmorItem.Type.LEGGINGS, new Item.Properties()));
